title.en: An Act Creating Three Additional Positions of Assistant City Fiscal in the City of Cebu by Amending the Charter of the Said City
title.orig: An Act Creating Three Additional Positions of Assistant City Fiscal in the City of Cebu by Amending the Charter of the Said City

text.en:
The last paragraph of Section thirty-seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered Fifty-eight, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred thirty-three is further amended to read as follows:
"The fiscal of the city and his assistants shall receive the salaries hereinafter set forth, which shall be paid by the City of Cebu; fiscal of the city, six thousand pesos per annum; first assistant fiscal, four thousand six hundred pesos per annum; second assistant fiscal, four thousand two hundred pesos per annum; and six third assistant fiscals, three thousand six hundred pesos per annum each."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
